Trainer down = CRITICAL - ML Analyzer down = HIGH - Causation links missing = HIGH - Neural/ML filter broken = MEDIUM  **Recommendations:** Remediation steps per issue  **Verification:** How to confirm fixes  ---  ## Data to Include  - Sample payloads, error logs, config values, performance data, system state - Neural metrics (loss, epsilon, organisms, training steps, buffer, optimization, events) - ML metrics (cluster count, anomaly count, phenotype events, collapse events, spike events) - Causation metrics (link counts by type, time window effectiveness, toggle effectiveness) - Visualization metrics (node/link counts by component, filter effectiveness, settings impact)  ---  ## Special Instructions  - **Neural Priority:** Enabled but trainer unavailable = CRITICAL - **ML Priority:** Enabled but analyzer unavailable = HIGH, sklearn import failure = HIGH - **Causation Priority:** Events exist but no links = HIGH, verify toggles/time windows - **Optimization Check:** Verify even if neural appears functional (may be silently disabled) - **Integration:** Neural events in graph, ML events in graph, metrics in shared state, causation settings applied, filters working, visualization controllable -
